title: Tiered signal combiner for optimization advisory routing
creator: Aisha Mukherjee
description:
Problem: Incoming enterprise optimization/advisory requests (batching/caching knobs, quantization profiles, routing policies) arrive with mixed signals (customer SLA, cost sensitivity, token volume, model compatibility, data residency constraints). Current routing is rules-based and brittle, causing misrouted requests that waste engineering time and delay customer outcomes.

Goal: Implement a tiered signal combiner that synthesizes multiple signals into a single routing score and lane assignment. The system should: 1) classify requests into lanes: Self-serve guidance, Concierge (Solutions Eng), or Eng Deep-dive; 2) surface the top contributing signals per request in the UI; 3) be tunable via feature flags and thresholds; 4) provide observability for calibration and regression detection.

Scope: PM scope is scoring schema, lane definitions, rollout plan, acceptance criteria, and stakeholder coordination. ENG will implement scoring service and routing hooks. Design will provide UI wireframes for per-request signal breakdown in the Console. This ticket covers the PM/coordination and the scoring spec.

Success metrics: 30% reduction in misrouted requests within 6 weeks of rollout, 20% faster time-to-first-response for Concierge lane, and reduction in Eng deep-dive tail-queue time by 25% for enterprise customers flagged high SLA.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Scoring spec doc published with signal definitions and weights. 2) Prototype scoring endpoint (staging) that returns lane + top-3 signals for a sample input. 3) Console wireframe with signal breakdown approved by design. 4) SLOs for routing latency and monitoring dashboards created. 5) A/B rollout plan and rollback criteria defined.
comments: 2025-02-14: Kickoff with Eng (Priya, Omar), Design (Eva). Agreed signals list: SLA tier, cost sensitivity, estimated token volume, model compatibility, prior optimization history, customer-requested timeline.
2025-02-20: PM + Eng spike completed. Engineering flagged telemetry gaps for 'estimated token volume' and 'prior optimization history' — added ENG-8287 to fill instrumentation before full rollout.
2025-02-26: Design sketch reviewed. Decided to show top-3 signals with both numeric score and human-readable reason; Design will deliver high-fidelity mockups by 2025-03-06.

2025-03-01: Weighting proposal reviewed with Solutions Eng. Two variants considered: static weight table (simpler) vs. logistic regression model trained on historical triage outcomes (more accurate but needs labeled data). Decision: ship static weights first for quick rollout, instrument labels for future ML model. Action: add sub-issue for ML model (PM-57458).
2025-03-03: Compliance flagged data residency signal mapping requires mapping to account-level policy. Security review requested. Filed SR-1123 for review; expect response by 2025-03-12.

2025-03-04: Rolled out prototype scoring endpoint to staging. Sample dashboard created: /dashboards/optimization-routing-staging. Next: run calibration sweep on 500 historical tickets to validate thresholds.
2025-03-04: Note: ENG requested that scoring endpoint be idempotent and cacheable for 24h to avoid repeat compute for bulk imports. Added dependency ENG-8302.
notes_and_tradeoffs: Trade-offs discussed: static weight table allows deterministic, auditable routing (favored for enterprise transparency) but will miss complex interactions between signals. ML-based ranker would improve accuracy but requires labeled historical data and introduces drift and explainability concerns. We will instrument and log labeled outcomes during the static rollout to seed an ML model later. Also considered latency vs. signal richness: final scoring should complete <200ms to avoid adding user-facing latency to ticket intake.
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Define signals + static weights (PM + Eng) -> Phase 2: Implement scoring endpoint + UI wireframes -> Phase 3: Staging calibration on historical tickets -> Phase 4: Canary rollout to 15% of requests with manual review hooks -> Phase 5: Full rollout and metrics evaluation. Backout plan: revert feature flag and fallback to existing rules-based router.
observability_requirements: Routing latency histogram, lane distribution, misroute rate (human-reclassified tickets), per-signal contribution distributions, weekly calibration report. Alerts: misroute_rate > 10% for 24h and routing_endpoint_error_rate > 0.5%.
owner_notes: Coordination touchpoints: weekly sync (Tues 10am) with Solutions Eng, Eng, and Design. PM will produce a runbook for operators and a short training deck for Solutions Eng triage team.
